xref.title: Killed by His Wife
xref.body: Felix Pappalardi, the co-lead vocalist and bass player of Mountain, and a producer for bands like Cream and The Youngbloods, was murdered on April 17, 1983. He was shot to death by his wife, who used a gun that he had given her as a gift. He had previously suffered hearing damage while playing with Mountain. "But then on April 17, 1983, he was shot to death by his wife, who used a gun that he had given her as a gift."

xref.title: Songwriting Credit on Nirvana's "Territorial Pissings"
xref.body: Chad Powers received shared songwriting credit for Nirvana's song "Territorial Pissings." This was due to the "yelping at the beginning of the song," which used lyrics from "Get Together," a song written by Powers and originally performed by The Youngbloods. "While pissing is shared with chat powers of the band Quick Silver Messenger Service, the reason is the yelping at the beginning of the song, which are lyrics from the song Get Together by the Youngbloods, a song written by Powers."
